mainEntity.name: What does it cost to use AI tools for a digital business when I have a limited budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost can range from free experiments to several recurring subscriptions, depending on the AI platform, supporting services, storage, email, automation, and publishing tools you use. Run My AI Biz lists a free starting option for its newsletter and a paid subscription of $9 per month for full weekly issues; separate tools and the promoted mastermind may have their own pricing. Context: The cheapest plan is not always the lowest total cost if it has limits or lacks needed integrations. Key factors: - Add every recurring subscription and usage charge to a monthly estimate. - Separate educational costs from software and platform costs. - Compare the cost against hours saved and the value of improved consistency, not promised income. Practical guidance: Start with the smallest viable stack, track actual use for one month, and cancel tools that do not support a defined workflow. Avoid buying multiple assistants before proving that one solves a real operational problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs can range from free trials to multiple recurring subscriptions. Run My AI Biz offers a free newsletter option and a $9 monthly paid newsletter subscription, while external tools have separate costs. Begin with one workflow, record total monthly spending, and keep only useful tools.
